audit.whatIsWrong: The chart was off by one row against its own whys on both layers: it gave Wukong Levels 3, 4-5, first item and 2+ items while whys[2], whys[3], whys[5] and whys[6] all say Lillia owns those stages, and it gave Lillia Level 1 where whys[0] says 'even opener'.
audit.why: The mirror (lillia__wukong) already aligned all seven rows to the prose in both layers, and the packet chart agrees: Skill, Lillia, Lillia, Lillia, Skill, Lillia, Lillia.
audit.corrected: All seven rows written as matched pairs on both layers with ratings following, and phases[1..6].why rewritten to describe the row they now carry.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[1..6].why were template strings claiming Wukong spikes at 3, 6 and first item.
audit.why: The actual spikes: she starts kiting at 2 as Blooming Blows stacks move speed, level 6 is the one even window because Lilting Lullaby needs Dream Dust already applied, and her first item DoT is where she pulls clear.
audit.corrected: All six rewritten with the mechanic and the number.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page's entire tracking rule was 'engage when Blooming Blows is down'. Blooming Blows is 6s at rank 1 and 4s at rank 5 — it is never meaningfully down.
audit.why: Riot's data: Q 6/5.5/5/4.5/4, 450 range, and its passive stacks move speed on every spell hit, which is the actual reason she out-spaces you. The punishable cooldown is Swirlseed at a flat 12s, 700 range — it is her slow, and without it she cannot hold you at range. Lilting Lullaby is 150s at rank 1 and only puts Drowsy on enemies who already carry Dream Dust, so it is not a standalone engage.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t re-keyed to Swirlseed and the Dream Dust prerequisite.

audit.why: There were no numbers on the page at all.
audit.corrected: Concrete waits added: engage into a spent Swirlseed (12s); do not plan around Blooming Blows, which returns in 4-6s.

notes: The page called Lillia 'he/his' throughout; fixed everywhere it appeared in a writable field. The tracking rule was pointed at the wrong ability — Blooming Blows is 4-6s and cannot gate an engage; Swirlseed's flat 12s can, and Lilting Lullaby needs Dream Dust already applied. Chart restated from the mirror, not re-derived. One unresolved tension is flagged in questionsForUser: the packet itself notes the win rate (55.8% for Wukong) disagrees with a chart that gives Lillia five of seven stages — I aligned the chart to the mirror and the prose rather than to the win rate, because changing the verdict would mean rewriting every why and the whole prose block on a guess.
